notes: The supplied text (catalog pages 167-168) prints no Culinary Management A.S. Degree section. It prints the Culinary Fundamentals, Culinary Management, and Culinary Professional Certificates of Achievement, plus the Culinary Menu Planning and Culinary Procurement and Cost Control Certificates of Completion. No blocks are recorded for the degree.

The nearest section is 'Culinary Management Certificate of Achievement'. Its requirements are: required CART 010, 012, 013, 020, 040, 042, 060, 064, BUHM 050, BUMA 001, and CIS 010 (4 units, printed after the page break on page 169). It also requires 12 elective units from BUMA 010/027/028/029 and CART 021/030/043/044/045/046/073/074/095A. Its printed CERTIFICATE TOTAL is 40. A reviewer should check whether the A.S. Degree appears elsewhere in the catalog (possibly on a nearby page) and whether it shares these requirements.

The certificate section prints learning outcomes and names 'management careers in the food service and lodging industries'. These were not recorded because they belong to the certificate section, not to a degree section.
The closed list includes CART 11, HS 13, HS 14, BUHM 63 and CART002, which do not appear anywhere in the text. This suggests the state file may reflect an older version of the degree.
